title: ACC announces 2027 schedule: 16 teams playing 9-game conference slate
dek: The ACC announced its 2027 conference schedule with 16 teams each playing nine league games for the first time. Clemson remains an exception, playing eight conference games due to preexisting nonconference commitments to Notre Dame and South Carolina. Every ACC team is required to play one Power 4 nonconference opponent.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: In 2027, the ACC will expand to a uniform nine-game conference schedule across all 16 teams, with Clemson as the sole exception playing eight games.
bottom_line: The ACC has locked in its 2027 structure with Clemson as a documented exception; the next scheduling inflection point arrives when the College Football Playoff determines its expansion model and ACC teams must align their conference calendars accordingly.
body: The ACC announced its 2027 conference schedule with 16 teams each playing nine league games for the first time, per ESPN. In 2026, only 12 teams play nine ACC games and five play eight ACC games due to preexisting nonconference commitments, according to ESPN.

Clemson will be the only ACC team playing eight conference games in 2027, per ESPN. The Tigers will play two Power 4 nonconference games that year: Notre Dame and South Carolina, according to ESPN. Every ACC team is required to play one Power 4 nonconference opponent each year, per ESPN.

The ACC is one of two Power 4 conferences that mandates each team play a minimum of 10 Power 4 opponents every year, according to ESPN. The 2027 schedule protects annual regional matchups including Miami-Florida State, Virginia-Virginia Tech, and NC State-North Carolina, per ESPN. All games in the 2027 ACC schedule occur at least two times over seven years, according to ESPN.
No decisions have been made about future schedules beyond 2027, given ongoing discussions at the College Football Playoff about possible expansion to a 24-team format, per ESPN.
